set.name: EP02
set.longname: Extended Play 02 — Universes Beyond: The Teams

card.name: Rumi, the Leader
card.text: Ascend (If you control ten or more permanents, you get the city's blessing for the rest of the game.) {WB}: Rumi gets +1/+1 until end of turn. As long as you have the city's blessing, Rumi is a Demon in addition to her other types and has "Whenever Rumi attacks, you may pay {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}. If you do, exile target nonland permanent."

card.name: Aaron Mitchell, Dinologist // Dino Studies
card.text:
Reach Whenever you attack with total power 6 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on Aaron.
---
Search your library for a creature card with power 6 or greater or a Dinosaur card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

card.name: Katie Mitchell, Filmographer // Film Mastery
card.text:
Prowess Noncreature spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
---
When you next cast a noncreature spell this turn, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.

card.name: Linda Mitchell, Guardian // Protective Drive
card.text:
Menace Linda gets +1/+0 for each creature you control.
---
Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Creatures you control gain first strike until end of turn.

card.name: Rick Mitchell, Survivalist // Road Trip
card.text:
At the beginning of each of your main phases, you may discard a card or sacrifice an artifact. If you do, draw a card.
---
Return up to X target nonartifact permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand.

card.name: Monchi, Peculiar Pet // Short Circuit
card.text:
Whenever you or a creature you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, Monchi deals 2 damage to each opponent.
---
Change the target of up to one target spell or ability with a single target.

card.name: Zoey, the Lyricist
card.text: Ascend (If you control ten or more permanents, you get the city's blessing for the rest of the game.) When Zoey enters, create an artifact token named Notebook with "{WU}, {T}: You and target opponent each draw a card." Whenever you draw a card, if you have the city's blessing, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.

card.name: Mira, the Choreographer
card.text: Ascend (If you control ten or more permanents, you get the city's blessing for the rest of the game.) Whenever you attack, you may pay {1}{RW}. If you do, create a red enchantment token named Dance Routine with "Creatures you control get +1/+0." During your turn, if you have the city's blessing, creatures you control have first strike.

card.name: Evil Eye, Jin Enjoji
card.text: Menace When Evil Eye enters, it deals X damage to up to one target creature, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard. Excess damage is dealt to that permanent's controller.

card.name: Turbo Granny, Ken Takakura
card.text: Haste Whenever Ken Takakura deals combat damage to a player, or an opponent casts a spell during your turn, that player loses 3 life unless they discard a card or sacrifices a creature.

card.name: Acrobatic Silky, Aira Shiratori
card.text: When Acrobatic Silky enters, create a 1/1 white Human creature token. Whenever you attack with a Spirit creature and a non-Spirit creature, up to two target creatures can't block until end of turn.

card.name: Momo Ayase, Novice Psion
card.text: When Momo Ayase enters, return up to one other target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, you may discard a card. If you do, or if your hand is empty, draw two cards.

card.name: Bloom of the Dragon Fire
card.text: Haste Valiant — Whenever Bloom becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, Bloom gets +1/+1 and gains flying until end of turn.

card.name: Vee, Realm Escapee
card.text: Ward {2} (Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {2}.) You may have Vee enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except her name is Vee, Realm Escapee, and she has her other abilities. {3}{U}{U}: Vee can't be blocked until end of turn.

card.name: Kyle Katayanagi, Fifth Ex
card.text: You may cast copies of artifact spells from your graveyard by putting the card on the bottom of your library in addition to paying the spell's other costs. Partner with Ken Katayanagi, Sixth Ex

card.name: Gideon Graves, Seventh Ex
card.text: When Gideon Graves enters, mill seven cards. When you do, return a card not named Gideon Graves, Seventh Ex with mana value 7 or less from your graveyard to your hand. Whenever you attack with 7 or more total power, each opponent loses 7 life unless they discard cards or sacrifice permanents with total mana value 7 or greater.

card.name: Amanda, Reckless Witch
card.text: As long as you've cast a noncreature spell this turn, Amanda has flying and haste. Whenever another Wizard you control enters, Amanda gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

card.name: Jasminka, Gourmand Witch
card.text: Whenever you cast a noncreature or Wizard spell, target creature, instant, or sorcery you control gains lifelink until end of turn. Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on Jasminka. Then if you have at least 8 life more than your starting life total, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.

card.name: Constanze, Mechanical Witch
card.text: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token. {U}, {T}: The next spell you cast this turn has improvise. (Your artifacts can help cast this spell. Each artifact you tap after you're done activating mana abilities pays for {1}.)

card.name: Sucy, Mushroom Witch
card.text: Deathtouch Afflict 3 (Whenever this creature becomes blocked, defending player loses 3 life.) Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, Sucy gets +1/+1 and gains noxious 1 until end of turn. (When she's blocked, defending player gets a poison counter for each point of noxious she has.)

card.name: Lotte Jansson, Communer
card.text: Spirited (When this permanent enters the battlefield, you may activate one of its activated abilities without paying its cost.) Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying. {4}{U}: You and target opponent each draw a card.

card.name: Diana, Cavendish Prodigy
card.text: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell from your hand, you may copy it. When you do, put that spell on the bottom of your library, then return target nonland card with lesser mana value from your graveyard to your hand if that card isn't a creature or if {W} was spent to cast that spell.

card.name: Atsuko Kagari, the Transfer
card.text: Whenever you cast a noncreature or Wizard spell, Atsuko Kagari gets +1/+1 until end of turn. {2}{U}, Discard a card: Until end of turn, Atsuko Kagari becomes a Mouse with hexproof.

card.name: Luz Noceda, Apprentice
card.text: When Luz enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card. {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: Exile target noncreature, nonland card from your graveyard with mana value 4 or less. Copy it. You may cast the spell without paying its mana cost. Activate only as a sorcery.

card.name: Natsuko, Story Fixer
card.text: Spirited (When this permanent enters the battlefield, you may activate one of its activated abilities without paying its cost.) {G}{U}{R}, {T}, Put a stun counter on Natsuko: Draw a card, then you may put a permanent card from your hand onto the battlefield. It gains haste until end of turn.

card.name: Ken Katayanagi, Sixth Ex
card.text: Whenever you cast an artifact spell, choose one— • You draw a card and lose 1 life. • Copy that spell. Partner with Kyle Katayanagi, Fifth Ex

card.name: Roxie Richter, Fourth Ex
card.text: Ninjutsu {2}{R}{R} ({2}{R}{R}, Return an unblocked attacker you control to hand: Put this card onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.) Whenever Roxie Richter enters or attacks, she fights up to one target creature you don't control. Excess damage dealt to that creature is dealt to its controller.

card.name: Matthew Patel, First Ex
card.text: Whenever you attack, create a tapped and attacking 1/1 red Demon Bard creature token. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.

card.name: Lucas Lee, Second Ex
card.text: Menace Whenever Lucas Lee or another creature you control dies while attacking, you may pay 1 life. If you do, create a Treasure token.

card.name: Todd Ingram, Third Ex
card.text: Whenever you cast your first noncreature spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Todd Ingram and draw a card. Whenever you cast a creature spell, Todd Ingram phases out. (Treat it and anything attached to it as though they don't exist until its controller's next turn.)

card.name: Luke Braveheart
card.text: Ward {2} (Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {2}.) Other creatures you control get +1/+1. Whenever Luke attacks, you may pay {3}{B}{B}. If you do, exile all nonland permanents.

card.name: Memmeln, Ceaseless Watcher
card.text: Reach Whenever Memmeln enters or attacks, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.) {5}{B}, Sacrifice Memmeln: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It's a 6/6 black Horror creature.

card.name: Justice, Resigned Hedonist
card.text: Whenever Justice enters or attacks, exile the top card of your library. You may play it during your next turn. {1}{B}{R}, Put a card exiled with Justice into its owner's graveyard: Justice gets +2/+0 and gains flying until end of turn.

card.name: Unio, Treasured Friend
card.text: Flying Prowess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.) Whenever you cast your first noncreature spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature you control.

card.name: Destiny, Kindhearted
card.text: Whenever another creature you control with power 2 or less enters, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn. {2}{G}: Until end of turn, Destiny becomes a Human Warrior, gets +X/+X, and gains trample, where X is the number of creatures you control. Activate only once each turn.

card.name: QJ, Alert Automaton
card.text: Flash Flying When QJ enters, return up to one target spell to its owner's hand.

card.name: Flora of the Plants
card.text: As long as you control a Faerie that's white, blue, black, or red, Flora has flying. Valiant — Whenever Flora becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, surveil 1. When you do, you may put a land card from your hand or graveyard onto the battlefield.

card.name: Musa of the Sound
card.text: Flying, prowess Valiant — Whenever Musa of the Sound becomes the target of a spell or you control for the first time each turn, when you next cast a noncreature spell this turn, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.

card.name: Tecna of the Future
card.text: Flying, vigilance Valiant — Whenever Tecna becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, search your library for a permanent card with mana value less than Tecna's power, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

card.name: Aisha of the Waves
card.text: Flying Valiant — Whenever Aisha becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, mill three cards, then return a card from among the milled cards to your hand. If that card wasn't a land or creature, copy it. You may cast the copy. (You still pay its costs.)

card.name: Roxy of the Animals
card.text: Flying, ward {2} Valiant — Whenever Roxy becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, create a 1/1 green Beast creature token, then put a +1/+1 counter on each token you control.

card.name: Stella of the Days
card.text: Flying, lifelink Valiant — Whenever Stella becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, untap target creature you control. It gets +1/+1 until end of turn. Then tap up to one target creature an opponent controls.

card.name: Gus Porter, Illusionist
card.text: When Gus enters and whenever you cast a spell with mana value 5 or greater, create a 0/1 blue Illusion creature token. While an opponent is choosing targets as part of casting a spell they control or activating an ability they control, that player must choose at least one Illusion if able.

card.name: Amity, Abomination Adept
card.text: When Amity enters, create a 1/1 black Ooze creature token. {4}{B}{G}: Put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature. It gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of permanent cards in your graveyard. Activate only once each turn.

card.name: Willow Park, Fierce Arborist
card.text: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on Willow. Whenever Willow attacks, you may pay {2}{R}{G}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control with lesser power than her.

card.name: Edalyn, the Owl Lady
card.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top card of your library. You may play a card exiled with Edalyn this turn. As long as there are one or less cards in your hand, Edalyn is a Bird Beast with base power and toughness 4/4 and "Spells you cast from anywhere other than your hand cost {2} less."

card.name: Lilith, Empire Mage
card.text: You have no maximum hand size. Whenever you attack, you draw a card and lose 1 life. Then if you have nine or more cards in your hand, you may cast any number of noncreature spells from your hand with mana value 9 or less without paying their mana costs.

card.name: Hunter, Golden Guard
card.text: When Hunter enters, you draw a card and lose 1 life. {2}{W}{B}, Sacrifice a nonland permanent: Return Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

card.name: King, Self-Proclaimed
card.text: King can't block. King gets +2/+1 and has menace as long as you've cast a spell with mana value 5 or greater this turn. Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 5 or greater, return King from your graveyard to your hand.

card.name: Hooty, the Owl House
card.text: {T}, Discard a card: Create two tapped Junk tokens. (They're artifacts with "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.") {T}, Sacrifice three artifacts: Add {R}{R}{R}. Exile target noncreature card from your graveyard. Copy it. You may cast the copy. (You still pay its costs, and may use the added mana to do so.)
